text.title: Flight of Malrik
text.body: Arch-Mage Malrik—the grand conspirator who leaked the northern border ciphers and sold Thornvael's defenses to the Iron Pact—flees up Ashveil Gorge toward a summit teleportation shrine. Cut him down before he vanishes with the secrets of the Caldera ritual.
text.obj.0: Pursue and slay Arch-Mage Malrik before he reaches the summit shrine
text.msg.1: Malrik's vanguard is spotted climbing Ashveil Gorge! Cut him off before he reaches that summit teleport shrine—if he completes his incantation, the Iron Pact's secrets vanish forever!
text.msg.2: Malrik bolts past the mid-gorge bend—cliff-snipers are opening fire from the ridge!
text.msg.3: He is sprinting for the summit flagstones! Run him down before he finishes the incantation!
text.msg.4: Malrik collapses clutching his scorched satchel. Here—the Royal Cipher-Keys and the Iron Pact Ledger! Gods above... Morvessa's northern Salt Tithe was meant to reinforce the Order Seals before the Pact hijacked the southern treasury and awakened the Caldera!
text.win: Arch-Mage Malrik is slain and the Royal Cipher-Keys expose the full architecture of the Caldera ritual.
text.fail.1: Your hero fell in Ashveil Gorge.
text.fail.2: Arch-Mage Malrik reached the summit shrine and vanished with the conspirators' ledgers.
